actions.title: Protect analyst capacity
actions.body: Freeze noncritical project work for two weeks to keep service throughput aligned to demand.

actions.title: Triage aging queue daily
actions.body: Assign executive visibility to work older than 7 days until the queue returns to target.

actions.title: Clarify escalation policy
actions.body: The same policy ambiguity is driving both resolution misses and repeat feedback themes.

events.title: Policy update release

feedback.prompt: This module should ultimately ingest field notes, surveys, emails, implementation issues, and escalation reviews into a common schema.
feedback.aggregationNote: Use LLMs to help cluster and summarize comments, but keep a governed taxonomy and human-reviewed definitions for the operating record.

entries.summary: Supervisors say the onboarding packet is too static and misses edge-case handling.
Users report the intake tool is slow during peak morning usage and they fall back to manual tracking.
Repeated requests are being escalated because policy exceptions are not clearly documented.
New leads want role-based job aids instead of generic reference material.
The weekly staffing plan does not reflect local seasonality, causing preventable overtime.
Teams are delaying updates until the end of shift because the tool slows down when too many records are open.
